musicRecommender.title: JP Solo music recommender
musicRecommender.description: Compare songs by estimated live score and event-point yields for your JP Solo inputs.
musicRecommender.sourceSwitchHint: Changing the source reloads music metadata. Results never fall back silently.
musicRecommender.controlsDescription: Enter your displayed total team power and other values to request recommendations.
musicRecommender.noSkillDescription: Ignore all six skill-rate inputs for this request.
musicRecommender.deckPowerInvalid: Enter a positive whole-number team power.
musicRecommender.boostInvalid: Enter a finite value greater than zero.
musicRecommender.durationNotRanked: Displayed as metadata only; not used for ranking.
musicRecommender.empty: No songs match these complete inputs.
musicRecommender.emptyDescription: Try a different metric or review the selected source.
musicRecommender.incomplete: Recommendations are unavailable until all required inputs are valid.
musicRecommender.fetchError: Music metadata could not be loaded from the selected source.
musicRecommender.fetchErrorDescription: Select the source again or try later. The other source was not selected automatically.
musicRecommender.invalidSource: The requested source is not supported. Choose a listed source to retry.
musicRecommender.httpError: The selected source rejected the request.
musicRecommender.invalidJson: The selected source did not provide valid music metadata.
musicRecommender.invalidSchema: The selected source is missing required music metadata fields.
musicRecommender.incompleteData: The selected source contains too few music records.
musicRecommender.mixedData: The selected source contains inconsistent music metadata.
musicRecommender.missingInputs: Complete all required inputs before requesting recommendations.
musicRecommender.invalidInputs: One or more request inputs are invalid. Review the highlighted fields.
musicRecommender.unsupportedRegion: Recommendations are not available for this region.
musicRecommender.regionNote: Uses Japanese song data. Songs released only in this region are not included.
musicRecommender.regionDataUnavailable: The song list for this region could not be loaded.
musicRecommender.unsupportedMode: This recommendation mode is not supported.
musicRecommender.unavailable: Recommendations are unavailable for the requested settings.
musicRecommender.planDescription: Find how many lives, and of which songs, reach a total score or event-point target. It uses the deck settings above and the same per-live values as the recommendations.
musicRecommender.planOverhead: Seconds per live besides the song
musicRecommender.planOverheadHint: Loading, results, and menus, as you time them yourself. Leave empty to plan without play time.
musicRecommender.planAllowRepeatsDescrip: When off, each song and difficulty is played at most once.
musicRecommender.planRequiredHint: Song ID and difficulty, separated by commas. Each is played at least once.
musicRecommender.planDeckInvalid: Fix the deck settings above first.
musicRecommender.planIdle: Enter a target total to see how many lives it takes.
musicRecommender.planInvalidSettings: Check the plan settings and try again.
musicRecommender.planYieldsUnavailable: A plan needs per-live values, and those are not available yet.
musicRecommender.planYieldsUnavailableHi: Complete the deck settings and make sure the music metadata loads, then plan again.
musicRecommender.planNoCandidates: No songs match the selected difficulties.
musicRecommender.planRequiredUnavailable: A required song is not available with these settings.
musicRecommender.planPlaysLimit: The target cannot be reached within the maximum number of lives.
musicRecommender.planTargetUnreachable: The target cannot be reached with these songs. Allow repeats or add difficulties.
musicRecommender.planOutOfBounds: This request is too large to solve exactly.
musicRecommender.planOutOfBoundsHint: The best plan could not be proven within the search limit. Try a slightly different target or lives limit, or choose fewest lives.
musicRecommender.planLiveBonusLimit: The target cannot be reached within the maximum live bonus.
musicRecommender.planBoostNotInTable: A live bonus limit needs a boost multiplier that the game offers. Change the boost multiplier or clear the limit.
musicRecommender.planLiveBonusUnavailabl: The boost table could not be loaded, so the live bonus limit cannot be applied. Try again later or clear the limit.
musicRecommender.planTimeRegionUnverifie: Shortest play time is only available for the JP server, where song lengths have been checked.
musicRecommender.planOptimalFewest: No plan uses fewer lives under these settings.
musicRecommender.planOptimalLeastOversho: No plan gets closer to the target under these settings.
musicRecommender.planOptimalShortestTime: No plan takes less play time under these settings.
musicRecommender.planAssumptionDeck: Every live uses the deck settings above, with the per-live values shown in the recommendations.
musicRecommender.planAssumptionLiveBonus: Every live is counted as {count} live bonus, the cost of the boost multiplier above in the game's boost table.
Lives at this boost multiplier use no live bonus, so the maximum live bonus has no effect.
The boost multiplier above is not one the game offers, so live bonus cannot be counted.
The boost table could not be loaded, so live bonus is not counted.
musicRecommender.planAssumptionPlayTime: Every live is counted as the length of its song plus {seconds} seconds, the time per live entered above.
musicRecommender.planAssumptionPlayTimeN: Play time is not counted, because no seconds per live were entered.
musicRecommender.planAssumptionPlayTimeR: Play time is not counted, because song lengths have only been checked for the JP server.
musicRecommender.planAssumptionLimits: Live bonus recovery is not part of the plan.
musicRecommender.planTargetInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100,000,000,000.
musicRecommender.planMaxPlaysInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10,000.
musicRecommender.planMaxLiveBonusInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000, or leave it empty.
musicRecommender.planOverheadInvalid: Enter a whole number of seconds from 0 to 3,600, or leave it empty.
musicRecommender.planOverheadRequired: Shortest play time needs the seconds per live. Enter a whole number from 0 to 3,600.
musicRecommender.planRepeatsRequired: Shortest play time needs repeats to be allowed.
musicRecommender.planRequiredInvalid: Use the form 12:master, separated by commas, with each song listed once.
